about: 회계 II 계획전표현황(E020523) — 오늘 날짜로 출금 · 예금 30,000 · 입금 · 어음 50,000 계획전표를 API 로 넣으면 캘린더 오늘 칸에 '예금(현금)감소 30 · 받을어음증가 50'(천단위), 구분을 현황으로 바꾸면 두 줄 '자금' · 계 80,000. 원본 2026-10-12 실측과 같다. 만든 장은 API 로 지운다.

shots.name: 준비 — 계획전표 둘(API)
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(() => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 36e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const tag = 'QA회계2 현황' + Date.now(); sessionStorage.setItem('fptag', tag); return Promise.all([window.__api('POST', '/fund-plans', { direction: 'OUT', planDate: d, method: 'DEPOSIT', amount: 30000, memo: tag }), window.__api('POST', '/fund-plans', { direction: 'IN', planDate: d, method: 'NOTE', amount: 50000, memo: tag })]).then((rs) => { sessionStorage.setItem('fpids', JSON.stringify(rs.map((r) => r.body.id))); return rs.map((r) => r.status).join(',') }) })()

shots.name: 캘린더 → 현황
steps: expect:(() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('td.bg-ec-blue-wash')][0]; return !!t && t.innerText.includes('예금(현금)감소') && t.innerText.includes('받을어음증가') && /감소\s*\n?\s*\d/.test(t.innerText) })()

js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status })); window.__api('POST', '/fund-plans/delete', { ids: JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('fpids')) }).then((r) => r.status)
